Hello,

Open the usage breakdown for the period to itemise charges by service and environment. Look for resources left running in staging or development environments, which are billed at the same rate as production. Check the billing period dates at the top of the invoice; the period runs from the anniversary of the subscription date rather than the first of the month. Set a usage alert on the billing page to notice unexpected accrual during the period rather than at the end of it.

If this does not solve the problem, reply to this message and a member of our support team will help you.

Sources:
- Understanding your invoice and usage breakdown (DOC-BILL-001), reviewed today
